title: Foundry Carve-Out Registry — Spec 036 amend-loop schema
description: Spec-036 amend-loop EXTENSION of the spec-032 carve-out registry schema at `infra/parameters/foundry-carveout.schema.json`. This file is the spec-036 contract anchor for the environment-aware quorum rule introduced in R3 Cluster A4 / Pass 2 Q-P2-03. It MUST be kept in sync with `infra/parameters/foundry-carveout.schema.json` (which is the runtime authority for CD enforcement). Differences from the spec-032 schema: (a) `environment` enum added at registry-row level; (b) `min_approvers_prod` (default 3) and `min_approvers_dev` (default 2) added at registry-root level; (c) the OPA rego at `infra/policy/rego/foundry_carveout.rego` MUST gain a matching `input.environment` discriminator (planned amend-loop bug-fix in Phase F-A4 — line 29 currently uses `< 2` which violates FR-RAG-CV-01 prod 3-approver requirement).

version.description: Registry schema version. Spec-036 amend-loop is `v >= 2`.

last_reviewed.description: ISO-8601 date of the last governance review of the registry as a whole (independent of per-row `review_date`).

reviewer_quorum.description: Minimum reviewer count for any registry mutation. Spec 032 baseline: 2. Spec-036 amend-loop tightens this to environment-aware via `min_approvers_prod` / `min_approvers_dev` below; existing `reviewer_quorum >= 2` retained as the lower bound.

min_approvers_prod.description: Minimum `approver_identities[]` count required when `environment == 'prod'`. Spec-036 R3 Cluster A4 / Pass 2 Q-P2-03: MUST be `>= 3`. The OPA rego at `infra/policy/rego/foundry_carveout.rego` enforces this via the `input.environment` discriminator (planned bug-fix at line 29).

min_approvers_dev.description: Minimum `approver_identities[]` count required when `environment in ('dev', 'staging')`. Spec-036 R3 Cluster A4: `>= 2` (existing spec-032 behaviour, preserved).

environment.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field. Discriminator for the environment-aware quorum rule. MUST match the target deployment environment so the OPA rego can apply the correct `min_approvers_*` floor.

approver_identities.description: Non-placeholder Entra IDs. The minItems floor is environment-aware: prod >= min_approvers_prod (default 3); dev/staging >= min_approvers_dev (default 2). Schema-level lower bound is 2 for backward compat with spec-032; OPA enforces the environment-aware floor at runtime.

review_date.description: ISO-8601 date. MUST be ≤ 12 months from CD apply (FR-RAG-CV-01); `scripts/verify-carveout.ps1` enforces (FR-RAG-CV-02).

allOf.$comment: Environment-aware approver-count rule. Schema cannot conditionally enforce minItems via if/then on a sibling property in JSON-Schema 2020-12 portable across all validators, so the OPA rego at `infra/policy/rego/foundry_carveout.rego` carries the binding rule. This allOf documents the intent for downstream tooling.

deployments.business_justification: Spec 036 FR-RAG-FM-01 — production inference for all agents and simulation chat (NN-2 §3 carve-out scope).
Spec 036 dev-environment evaluation runs for the eval-runner equivalence-gate harness.
